name: Marrying A Single Mother
overview: Scripture upholds the sanctity of marriage as a covenant where a man and woman become one flesh, emphasizing faithfulness and purity in the relationship. Jesus teaches that looking at a woman with lust is already a violation of this covenant, and He clearly condemns divorce and remarriage except in the case of fornication, warning that marrying someone who has been put away unlawfully constitutes adultery. These teachings highlight the importance of honoring marital commitments and approaching marriage with reverence and obedience to God's design, including the responsibility and care involved when marrying a single mother.
